summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by building ask-soony: an agent product that polls the Soony portal, finds contradictions between the launch plan and the supplier/ERP documents, and acts on them (supplier emails, approvals, escalations) for a senior buyer and a procurement head.
summary.outcome: Analyzed the data and found the Collector's Edition and Standard shortfalls, built a poller, extraction and recompute pipeline, a Today/Launch UI, a sign-off loop, a demo instance and a README, and published briefing docs. The jonas/today-flow branch is pushed at 3468eb8; later commits (demo script, options count, calmer numbers) are local only.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path}, /archive.zip), no webhooks or notifications. Changes must be detected by polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, because existing files are replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored data/ folder (raw, drops, img, notes); .env is gitignored and .env.example is committed. No data values go into code or the repo.
Repo has a team workflow (CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS.md) that must be read and claimed before work. Entire hooks write checkpoints only when repo files changed, and they push checkpoints on git push.

Two instances exist: live (sends real supplier emails) and a demo instance at ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev that records emails in data/demo/state/dry_outbox.json. It is managed via scripts/demo.sh reset|snapshot|stop, with CALLS=twilio to enable real calls.

Phone calls are dry_run by default via ASK_CALL_PROVIDER in .env. Real Twilio calls cost about $0.38/min. ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds> auto-approves passed-on escalations, marked as simulated. ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK is still empty.
The web UI polls state every 5s (POLL_MS = 5000) and routines every 15s; there is no server push.
Sign-off loop: signoff.py, OkPage.tsx and /ok/<token> give one-time, no-password approval links, which basic_auth.py lets through. Push goes to every subscribed device, with no per-person routing.
Mailbox sync previously wrote back a stale copy of the action log and lost records. Fixed by appending under the shared lock (commit dd71984) with a test.
Prepared steps now expire when their case is decided and are deduplicated across routines. The Today left column groups prepared steps per routine instead of per step.
J/K navigation now moves row by row over folded groups; a row stays highlighted while any case in its group is open.

Data findings: art-book receipt WZ-261116-473 was overbooked at 80,000 instead of 8,000; 5,600 statues failed inspection but were booked as unrestricted; lid magnets are a false alarm (fitted by PackRight); Karton Nowak's 8,000-art-book offer closes the gap; the Category Lead Collector's Items post is vacant and so blocks the waiver.
workflow: Use subagents for parallel bulk work (cross-checking 200 order confirmations and 59 scans, building the sign-off loop) and verify with tests, tsc and browser screenshots before committing.
Check for user edits to a Claude doc before updating it, to avoid overwriting.
Ask before irreversible or paid actions: real supplier emails, DNS changes in the user's Cloudflare zone, paid phone calls, pushes.
Keep confidential data out of docs and the repo; do not copy the portal login from chat into docs.
Publish demo-safe instances with dry-mail modes so rehearsal never emails real suppliers.
